en: ...I see. I don't know either...{wait}{clear}What she said, that the nobles set a trap for my brother and me, isn't hard to believe, but...{wait}{clear}...Damn it... I can't be sure of anything...{wait}{clear}And by the same token, I can't know that she didn't do it...{wait}{clear}
What I need to do now is fight the chaos.{wait}{clear}Once it's all over, I'll go back home...{wait}{clear}

Please, be careful.{wait}{clear}

I... can't run away now...{wait}{clear}The enemy's still doing the same kind of thing, making lots of people suffer.{wait}{clear}I know that...{wait}{clear}But I...{wait}{clear}.....{wait}{clear}

No matter how much you tell me that, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I just don't have the confidence...{wait}{clear}In the end, I lost everyone who mattered to me...{wait}{clear}

Rudi... Didn't you do everything you could, each and every time?{wait}{clear}And there are still... things we must do...{wait}{clear}I understand how you feel. The past is not easy to forget...{wait}{clear}But there is still... a future we must protect...{wait}{clear}
Do you regret what you've done so far?{wait}{clear}
It's not that... More than regret...{wait}{clear}
...I just can't bear it.{wait}{clear}How powerless I am...{wait}{clear}.....{wait}{clear}
...It's raining.{wait}{clear}

Whining in the rain, huh...{wait}{clear}Maybe my brother's angry... Telling me to quit saying pathetic things.{wait}{clear}My brother never once complained.{wait}{clear}The last time I saw him was the first time I heard it...{wait}{clear}To me, my brother was perfect... and yet...{wait}{clear}.....{wait}{clear}I often remember playing with him when we were little.{wait}{clear}He was good at everything... I loved tagging along after him.{wait}{clear}I can't... follow after my brother anymore...{wait}{clear}
Your brother's feelings...{n}
Even if it's painful...{n}

Yeah, I know.{wait}{clear}...I have to go on alone now. As a man.{wait}{clear}I can't close my eyes or run away anymore...{wait}{clear}Because my brother never did...{wait}{clear}Thank you... ＄＄＄＄＄＄. For listening to me like this.{wait}{clear}I've finally sorted out how I feel...{wait}{clear}

Yeah... You're right.{wait}{clear}I have to protect what my brother was trying to protect.{wait}{clear}That's what I have to do...{wait}{clear}Sorry... for making you listen to me whine like this...{wait}{clear}But I've sorted out how I feel. I'll move forward... for the things I have to protect.{wait}{clear}
Not right now...{wait}{clear}

Defeat the Heavenly Dragon...{wait}{clear}
Can I really do that...?{wait}{clear}
...No, I'm the one who has to do it, right, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?{wait}{clear}
For my brother and the others...{wait}{clear}
No... for this world that the people who believed in me held so dear...{wait}{clear}
I'll defeat the Heavenly Dragon. I swear...{wait}{clear}
When all the fighting's over, will you go back to the Heavens?{wait}{clear}
To me... you're someone really precious...{wait}{clear}
I've realized that clearly now...{wait}{clear}
We've fought together all this time... and I... can't say how much it helped me, having you there...{wait}{clear}
Please... won't you stay in this world...?{wait}{clear}
I want you by my side... from now on, always.{wait}{clear}
Yes... All right. I will stay in this world.{wait}{clear}
I was hoping you'd say that...{wait}{clear}
I'll become a man worthy of you. I promise...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... Rudi...{wait}{clear}As an angel, I must work for the Heavens. Now and always...{wait}{clear}I cannot stay in this world...{wait}{clear}
Yeah, of course...{wait}{clear}

My bad...{wait}{clear}

Pawooo!{wait}{clear}

Pawooo!{wait}{clear}
